image_description: A lionfish swimming underwater against a dark, sandy seabed background. The fish displays characteristic vertical reddish-brown and white stripes on its body. It has large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays that appear translucent blue-green due to lighting or filter effects. The dorsal fin spines are visible fanning out from the back. The head is large with a visible eye.
